shortDescription: implements rest api for DNS configuration

options.name: api_version
options.description: Configures (force) API version (vX.Y) for acces to the remote device.

options.name: dns_config_mode
options.description: DNS Configuration Mode, default is DCM_DHCP

options.name: dns_domain_names
options.description: The first  manually configured DNS server domain name, all DNS configurations need to be made in a single module call, to remove configuration pass in empty string ""

options.name: dns_domain_names_2
options.description: The second  manually configured DNS server domain name, all DNS configurations need to be made in a single module call, to remove configuration pass in empty string ""

options.name: dns_domain_names_3
options.description: The third  manually configured DNS server domain name, all DNS configurations need to be made in a single module call, to remove configuration pass in empty string ""

options.name: dns_domain_names_4
options.description: The fourth  manually configured DNS server domain name, all DNS configurations need to be made in a single module call, to remove configuration pass in empty string ""

options.name: dns_domain_names_5
options.description: The fifth  manually configured DNS server domain name, all DNS configurations need to be made in a single module call, to remove configuration pass in empty string ""

options.name: host
options.description: Specifies the DNS host name or address for connecting to the remote device over the specified transport. The value of host is used as the destination address for the transport.

options.name: password
options.description: Specifies the password to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. This value is used to authenticate the SSH session. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable ANSIBLE_NET_PASSWORD will be used instead.

options.name: port
options.description: Specifies the port to use when building the connection to the remote device.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: server_1
options.description: The first manually configured DNS Server IP address with priority 1, all DNS configurations need to be made in a single module call, to remove configuration pass in empty string ""

options.name: server_2
options.description: The second manually configured DNS Server IP address with priority 2, all DNS configurations need to be made in a single module call

options.name: server_3
options.description: The third manually configured DNS Server IP address with priority 3, all DNS configurations need to be made in a single module call, to remove configuration pass in empty string ""

options.name: server_4
options.description: The fourth manually configured DNS Server IP address with priority 4, all DNS configurations need to be made in a single module call, to remove configuration pass in empty string ""

options.name: ssh_keyfile
options.description: Specifies the SSH key to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. This value is the path to the key used to authenticate the SSH session. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable ANSIBLE_NET_SSH_KEYFILE will be used instead.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Specifies the timeout in seconds for communicating with the network device for either connecting or sending commands. If the timeout is exceeded before the operation is completed, the module will error.

options.name: use_ssl
options.description: Configures use SSL (HTTPS) for access to the remote device.

options.name: username
options.description: Configures the username to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. This value is used to authenticate the SSH session. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable ANSIBLE_NET_USERNAME will be used instead.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Configures validation of certification for access to the remote device.

options.name: version_1
options.description: The ip version of first manually configured DNS Server. (V6 is not supported via REST)

options.name: version_2
options.description: The ip version of second manually configured DNS Server. (V6 is not supported via REST)

options.name: version_3
options.description: The ip version of third manually configured DNS Server. (V6 is not supported via REST)

options.name: version_4
options.description: The ip version of fourth manually configured DNS Server. (V6 is not supported via REST)
